## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive (narrow/weak). VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) ↓ falling and credit proxies mixed (HYG CORRECTION 1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17%; LQD BELOW TREND 1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41%) — conflicting signals support the NEUTRAL regime.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing via VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) ↓ falling; credit conditions uneven with HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41%) ↓ falling. Commodity reflation (BNO 1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45% ABOVE TREND) is a second-order risk driver.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Duration pressure mild: TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) ↓ falling, suggesting slightly firmer yields. Credit mixed with HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41%) ↓ falling — net neutral-to-tightening tone.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities constructive: (sector 1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%). Tech showing limited upside vs leaders: XLK (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND while Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND; style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US broad market steady: SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND. Emerging markets outpacing: EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.19%) RECOVERY — EM strength contrasts narrow US sector breadth.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative risk on: IBIT (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND; small-cap IWM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY — appetite exists but concentrated.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity bid led by oil and agriculture: BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND, UGA (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +19.68%) ABOVE TREND; metals mixed with GLD CORRECTION (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) and SLV CORRECTION (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +7.11%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy momentum strong: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas supportive: UNG (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Energy and EM show both short- and medium-term strength (XLE ABOVE TREND, EEM ABOVE TREND). Divergence: several commodities and safe-haven metals in CORRECTION (WEAT 1W: -5.39% | 1M: +11.68% CORRECTION; GLD 1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39% CORRECTION) — minor-to-moderate mismatches, not a broad regime break.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy and EM ETFs given momentum (XLE 1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14% ABOVE TREND; EEM 1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66% ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak cyclicals like XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND and XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND; monitor XLK (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05%) for leadership re-acceleration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND if oil (BNO) momentum persists. BEARISH: XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND and XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND if breadth stays weak.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: WEAT (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +11.68%) CORRECTION and GLD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION if risk appetite reverses.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency marker); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot); XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot); SPY recent support zone near short-term 1M mean (monitor).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, with mixed risk signals (VXX BELOW TREND but credit and breadth uneven). Energy and EM showing relative strength (XLE 1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14% ABOVE TREND; EEM 1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66% ABOVE TREND); watch narrow breadth and commodity/metal corrections (WEAT, GLD, SLV) for spillover.
